Adjusted using the Financial Stability Report: While the FOMC statement already conveys a cautious tone (elevated inflation and ongoing tightening), the FSR around this period highlights additional headwinds—tighter financial conditions, strained market liquidity in Treasuries and agency MBS, vulnerabilities in nonbank intermediation, and elevated uncertainty—partly offset by resilient bank capitalization and liquidity. Netting these, the sentiment should be slightly more negative than the original.
